reason: OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint enforces OrganizationAuditPermission (src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py:40, src/sentry/api/bases/organization.py:110-123), requiring the org:write scope (only manager/owner roles in src/sentry/conf/server.py:2166-2265, never granted by open membership) or is_active_superuser before get() executes, so regular members of open-membership orgs cannot reach the advanced paginator at all. Additionally, src/sentry/api/endpoints/organization_auditlogs.py:71 checks organization_context.member.has_global_access—the legacy OrganizationMember BooleanField defaulting to True (src/sentry/models/organizationmember.py:216)—rather than request.access.has_global_access (src/sentry/auth/access.py:420-430), so open membership neither controls the flag nor widens access.
